name: Vitest
one_liner: Vite-native test runner with a Jest-compatible API.
what_it_is: A unit test runner powered by Vite, reusing its configuration and transform pipeline, with an API Vitest describes as a drop-in replacement in most projects, and a watch mode built on Vite’s dev server.
why_it_matters: Vitest removed the long-standing annoyance of maintaining a second, divergent build configuration purely for tests. If your project already uses Vite, there is very little argument for running Jest alongside it. The migration is usually far smaller than teams expect.
suitable_for: Any project already building with Vite
Migrating from Jest with minimal test rewrites
not_suitable_for: React Native projects, where Jest remains better supported
Codebases depending on Jest-specific plugins with no equivalent
